description: DialogflowConversationDataset is the Schema for the DialogflowConversationDataset API

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: DialogflowConversationDatasetSpec defines the desired state of DialogflowConversationDataset

description.description: Optional. The description of the dataset. Maximum of 10000 bytes.

displayName.description: Required. The display name of the dataset. Maximum of 64 bytes.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The DialogflowConversationDataset name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: DialogflowConversationDatasetStatus defines the config connector machine state of DialogflowConversationDataset

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the DialogflowConversationDataset resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

conversationCount.description: Output only. The number of conversations this conversation dataset contains.

conversationInfo.description: Output only. Metadata set during conversation data import.

languageCode.description: Optional. The language code of the conversation data within this dataset. See https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/standard_fields for more information. Supports all UTF-8 languages.

createTime.description: Output only. Creation time of this dataset.

inputConfig.description: Output only. Input configurations set during conversation data import.

gcsSource.description: The Cloud Storage URI has the form gs://<Google Cloud Storage bucket name>//agent*.json. Wildcards are allowed and will be expanded into all matched JSON files, which will be read as one conversation per file.

uris.description: Required. Google Cloud Storage URIs for the inputs. A URI is of the form: `gs://bucket/object-prefix-or-name` Whether a prefix or name is used depends on the use case.

satisfiesPzi.description: Output only. A read only boolean field reflecting Zone Isolation status of the dataset.

satisfiesPzs.description: Output only. A read only boolean field reflecting Zone Separation status of the dataset.
